description: Road closures in Puerto Rico standing now, as reported in the public stories 787daily published (an outlet, the Police, the Highway Authority or Metropistas through them): `current` is in force now, `planned` is announced ahead. Each row gives the road ('PR-52 (Luis A. Ferré)'), the town, the status (Closed, Partly closed, Lane closed), why, the timing, and whose report and when, linking its row on 787daily.com/live/roads/. Filter by `town` (one of the 78, accents optional; a community such as Levittown finds its town) and/or `road` ('PR-52', '52'). An empty list means none reported, which is not proof a road is clear. This is the NEWS lane only: live traffic incidents (crashes reported by a traffic feed as they happen) are shown on 787daily.com/live/roads/ and are not available through this tool. Cite 787daily.com/live/roads/ and the reporting outlet.

town.description: A town (municipio), e.g. 'Caguas' or 'san-juan'; omit for the island
